guard: cotal models reads each connector's catalog from a real manager: a catalog the connector could not read, or an installed connector the manager could not load, makes the listing partial with exit 4 and fails a read of that one connector with exit 5, and a connector whose install lists no catalog is supported: false with its reason, a complete read
why: The suite drives the built binary against managers running in the suite on a real broker, with connectors registered in the shared registry, so each mutation rebuilds and the restore rebuilds back.
Before the connector could report a catalog unavailable, OpenCode 2.x threw, and every listing on a machine with it installed came back partial with exit 4.

mutations.name: a catalog the install cannot list is reported as supported
mutations.expectRed: a catalog the install cannot list is supported: false with its reason, complete, exit 0, no warning
mutations.cell: a catalog the install cannot list is supported: false with its reason, complete, exit 0, no warning

mutations.name: an unreadable catalog leaves the listing complete
mutations.expectRed: every catalog with one unreadable is partial, exit 4, with MODEL_CATALOG_UNREADABLE naming only that one
mutations.cell: every catalog with one unreadable is partial, exit 4, with MODEL_CATALOG_UNREADABLE naming only that one

mutations.name: a connector the manager could not load is not counted as unread
mutations.expectRed: an installed connector that cannot load is partial, exit 4, with MODEL_CATALOG_UNREADABLE naming only that one
mutations.cell: an installed connector that cannot load is partial, exit 4, with MODEL_CATALOG_UNREADABLE naming only that one

mutations.name: the report drops why the install lists no catalog
mutations.expectRed: the report gives the reason the install lists no catalog and no failure
mutations.cell: the report gives the reason the install lists no catalog and no failure

mutations.name: the report shows a load failure as a missing catalog
mutations.find: if (row.error) blocks.push({ kind: "lines", lines: [{ text: row.error, tone: "failed" }] });
mutations.replace: if (row.error && row.supported) blocks.push({ kind: "lines", lines: [{ text: row.error, tone: "failed" }] });
mutations.expectRed: the report names the load failure under that connector, not a missing catalog
mutations.cell: the report names the load failure under that connector, not a missing catalog

mutations.name: a read of the one unreadable catalog succeeds
mutations.find: return result.error ? { ok: false, error: result.error } : { ok: true, data: result };
mutations.expectRed: the one catalog --agent names could not be read: failed, exit 5, with the connector's reason
mutations.cell: the one catalog --agent names could not be read: failed, exit 5, with the connector's reason
